I strongly feel this problem is due to lack of knowledge in achieving taharah after passing urine. I would humbly request you to guide me to get rid of this problem and pray to ALLAH that my problem of taharah is solved. Please pray for me that I become a good HAFIZ E QUARN, follow the Sharia'h properly and become a good DAEE E DEEN. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 48800 Country: India Title: Purity Question: I recently got married. My question is that sometimes we delay in taking ghusl after humbistari. In this condition of napaki, does the bed sheet, pillow cover, clothes we wear or any other thing that we touck also becomes napaak. If yes then how to make it paak again? Further during humbistari, if some liquid drop falls on the bed sheet, then does it also become napaak. If yes, then how to make it paak again. Please respond at the earliest. Answer ID: 48800 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1680/1231/H=11/1434) (1) Nothing like bed, chuddar, pillow or cover turns impure by touching. (2) If the semen is smeared with the chuddar then the portion shall turn impure where the impurity is smeared. (3) Wash that much part which is impure , it is enough and the chuddar will remain tahir (pak/clean). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
